thread:
Luis (support): FYI getting an escalation from AcmeCorp — they hit quota but are seeing 5xx from our API instead of 429. customer says it's blocking production traffic. sample req id: req-ACME-44321. can SRE/runtime triage? :rotating_light:

Priya (eng-runtime): Can you paste the raw response they saw and any headers? also which region?

Luis (support): pasted from the customer:```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" -H "X-Request-ID: req-ACME-44321" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
x-request-id: req-ACME-44321
x-upstream-service: quota-orch
x-upstream-status: 504
x-dep-error: DEADLINE_EXCEEDED
{"error":"upstream timeout"}
```
They're in us-west-2. ticket: SUP-21234. Customer calls it a regression — they used to get 429 when they exceeded quota.

Maya (eng-sre): I can see a spike in quota-orch dependency_timeouts around 2026-03-15T10:11:xxZ in us-west-2. traces show calls falling back to rate-proxy which returns 500 if it can't classify. looks like quota-orch returned a hard timeout instead of an explicit quota-reject. suspect a misroute to the new orch canary.

Olivia (oncall): DeployBot shows a quota-orch deploy at 2026-03-15T10:05:12Z -> image: quota-orch:3.2.1 with retry + grpc-deadline changes. OpsAlertBot fired a Sev3 at 10:12 for elevated 5xx ratio on /v1/generate.

Priya (eng-runtime): If quota-orch's new behavior surfaces a dependency timeout, our gateway should map that to 429 for quota-related errors. looks like mapping logic got stricter and falls through to 5xx on DEADLINE_EXCEEDED. can someone reproduce a raw request hitting the same path?

Luis (support): I asked the customer for a curl with full headers; they sent the above. they also gave their client retry pattern which increases pressure.

Maya (eng-sre): Quick check of service topology: requests hit api-gateway -> auth -> rate-proxy -> quota-orch (grpc) then back. When quota-orch times out, rate-proxy currently classifies only explicit quota_reject codes as 4xx. DEADLINE_EXCEEDED is treated as upstream failure -> 5xx.

Nikhil (eng-platform): I can push a temporary routing override to send quota checks to quota-orch-v1 (stable) in us-west-2. That should restore 429 behavior. Want me to do that now?

Olivia (oncall): Please do it. this is customer-impacting. label as P1 until mitigated.

Nikhil (eng-platform): Running admin command now:```
curl -XPOST https://ops.internal/route-override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ops-token" \
  -d '{"service":"quota-orch","target":"quota-orch-v1","region":"us-west-2"}'
```

DeployBot: route-override accepted -> quota-orch traffic in us-west-2 now routed to quota-orch-v1.

Maya (eng-sre): Observability: 30s after override the 5xx rate dropped and we see 429s again for several sampled requests. confirming with synthetic:```
# synth repro (from us-west-2 test agent)
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-TEMP" -H "X-Request-ID: repro-0001" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"quota test"}'
# before override we saw 500/x-upstream-status:504; after override we see 429/x-quota-reason:rate_limit
```

Priya (eng-runtime): OK rollback/override worked as mitigation. Next: need a proper fix so dependency DEADLINE_EXCEEDED from quota-orch maps to 429 at the gateway OR quota-orch should return explicit quota_reject messages even on heavy load. This is a product/runtime contract mismatch introduced by 3.2.1.

Luis (support): Customer notified and verified receipt. they still want root cause and ETA for permanent fix.

Maya (eng-sre): Root cause hypothesis: 3.2.1 changed grpc deadlines/retries, higher chance of internal deadline before quota check completes. Instead of returning quota_reject proto, quota-orch times out and the rate-proxy doesn't have a fallback mapping to treat deadline as quota.

Priya (eng-runtime): Proposed fixes (short term -> long term):
1) Short term: add gateway mapping: treat quota-orch DEADLINE_EXCEEDED/DEADLINE_EXCEEDED-grpc as 429 with reason "quota_timeout". This is low-risk config and quick.
2) Medium: revert the retry/deadline behavior in quota-orch 3.2.1 (patch release 3.2.2) to ensure explicit proto responses under load.
3) Long term: standardized error taxonomy across quota-orch and rate-proxy; contract tests in CI to prevent regressions.

Nikhil (eng-platform): I'll keep the route override for 1h while we implement short-term gateway mapping.

Maya (eng-sre): Creating an internal incident doc: INC-2026-03015-quota-orch-timeout. adding graphs, traces, customer impact.

Priya (eng-runtime): I'll open a PR to add the gateway error mapping now and a follow-up to patch quota-orch. Command to update gateway (example):```
# gateway admin API
curl -X PATCH https://gateway.admin.internal/config -H "Authorization: Bearer ops-token" -d '{"map_errors": [{"upstream":"quota-orch","match":"DEADLINE_EXCEEDED","map_to":429,"reason":"quota_timeout"}]}'
```

Olivia (oncall): Assigning action items: Priya -> implement gateway mapping and PR (ETA 2 hours). Maya -> monitor metrics & confirm 429s (ETA 30m). Nikhil -> hold route override (1h) and prepare rollback plan (ETA 1h). Luis -> update customer with mitigation and next steps.

Maya (eng-sre): quick notes for postmortem: reproducer for QA: run a synthetic that injects delay to quota-orch handler to trigger a DEADLINE_EXCEEDED and observe gateway mapping. repro steps:```
# on test cluster
kubectl run -i --rm debug --image=radial/busybox -- sh -c "apk add curl; curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-TEMP\" -H \"X-Quota-Test: delay=1200ms\" https://api.test.redwood/v1/generate"
# OR use dev proxy header
curl -H "X-Test-Inject-Failure: quota-timeout" -H "X-Request-ID: repro-002" https://api.dev.redwood/v1/generate
```

Priya (eng-runtime): Tests to add: CI contract test asserting that any grpc DEADLINE_EXCEEDED from quota-orch yields a mapped 4xx at gateway. Also add load test scenario that ramps client retries.

Luis (support): Customer updated. they responded: "Thanks for the quick mitigation. Please keep us posted on a permanent fix."

OpsAlertBot: Alert resolved (5xx ratio down to baseline) after route override.

Olivia (oncall): Thanks team. keep this thread for the postmortem and link incident doc. will move to postmortem once RCA done. :white_check_mark:
